prior_mapping_finding: C0 observability-adapter-mapping.json owns logical names and cgroup/load-generator collection but does not map production Prometheus names (service_mapping_status CONFIG_REQUIRED_NOT_QUALIFIED). Oracle adapter identity-maps the 15 correctness names to a correctness exporter marked REQUIRED_NOT_QUALIFIED. No production-name mapping existed to reuse.

Redis INFO used_cpu_sys + used_cpu_user. Not in the 7-pod scrape (Redis was not captured).
Actor-turn execute latency on player/farm (task only). Gate should use farmgate_ws_handle_latency_seconds; worker has no turn histogram. Contract name is ambiguous across subtrains.
HELP is current active websocket connections — the same gauge.
PRE_AUTH exits by result (authenticated=ClientHello activation). farmgate_ws_conn_total is TCP/WS accept, not protocol handshake.
Time spent waiting for ClientHello activation, which is the handshake interval. HandleBinary latency is all frames.
HELP is total business frames received.
HELP is total business frames sent.
HELP is total bytes sent to clients.
HELP is currently queued downlink items across local writers.
HELP is currently queued downlink bytes across local writers.
HELP is age of the oldest queued downlink frame.
No gate subscription-lane depth gauge. writer_queue_items is all FrameKinds; farm_subscription_hub_active_lanes is farm-svr lane count, not depth.
No subscription-lane oldest-age gauge. oldest_frame_age_seconds is max over all downlink kinds, not subscription lanes.
HELP is slow clients kicked due to full send queue.
Histogram of items per holder-isolated lease dispatch; filter label lane=session_route (present in this scrape).
Same batch, lane=session_route. HELP says conservative estimated wire/storage bytes, not measured wire bytes.
Physical Redis/gRPC dispatch duration of the lease batch; filter lane=session_route.
Same family, filter lane=subscription. This scrape only had session_route series (histogram children appear after first observation).
lane=subscription estimated bytes. This scrape had no subscription series; values are estimates not wire truth.
BatchRenewSubscriptions RPC round-trip, which is the subscription-lane dispatch duration. Present in this scrape.
No per-lease remaining histogram. farm_gate_boot_lease_seconds_remaining is one GateBoot gauge. route-controller exports route_snapshot_min_remaining_ms (min remaining ms, different object).
Active keyed actor mailboxes with actor_kind=player. Same live actor count.
player-svr does not call RegisterActivationMetrics; farm_actor_activation_* absent from player-svr-0/1 scrape. No activation_total counter exists even on farm.
No load/activation duration histogram in capture or Go source (grep activation_latency/load_and_claim/LoadLatency).
Activation FSM not registered on player-svr. farm_actor_mailbox_retired_total is mailbox retire, not PASSIVATING→ABSENT.
Queued user turns across this process (actor_kind=player). mailbox_queued also includes system turns.
Queued user mailbox payload bytes across this process.
Contract is a per-turn wait histogram. farm_actor_user_mailbox_oldest_wait_seconds is a gauge of the current oldest head wait, not the same distribution.
HELP: actor turn execution latency, task only, queue wait excluded. Separate mailbox_wait metric in the contract makes this the execute half.
No production histogram. cap-redis uses this only as a scenario operation name, not a metric.
Same commit-envelope serialization duration, labeled domain=player. Unit is milliseconds — adapter must convert.
No Authority Commit duration histogram. serialization_duration_ms is envelope sizing only; redis_round_trips is a count.
Histogram of logical Authority Commit request bytes (domain=player). Adapter value=sum is cumulative bytes; type is histogram not counter.
No live-actor RAM histogram. actor_record_serialized_bytes / model_state_bytes are serialized payload sizes, not in-process actor memory.
Internal gRPC handler latency. Participant steps are method=ExecuteStep on CoordinatorParticipantService; unfiltered family also includes other methods.
Active keyed actor mailboxes with actor_kind=farm.
Activation metrics exist on farm-svr but there is no all-activations counter. reactivated_total is only loads after passivation, not cold starts.
farm_actor_activation_* are gauges/counters of FSM/load gates; no load-duration histogram in source or scrape.
HELP: completed PASSIVATING to ABSENT passivations. Present on farm-svr-0/1, actor_kind=farm.
Queued user turns across this process (actor_kind=farm).
Queued user mailbox payload bytes across this process.
Same gap as player: oldest_wait_seconds is a gauge of the current oldest head, not a per-turn wait histogram.
Actor turn execution latency (task only, queue wait excluded), actor_kind=farm.
No production histogram. cap-redis scenario name only.
Same serialization duration, domain=farm. Unit milliseconds; farm-svr-1 scrape lacked series (no commits).
No commit-duration histogram. serialization_duration_ms is envelope sizing only.
Histogram of logical Authority Commit request bytes (domain=farm); use adapter value=sum. Absent on farm-svr-1 in this scrape.
No live-actor RAM histogram. actor_record_serialized_bytes / model_state_bytes are serialized sizes.
No join counter. farm_rpc_calls_total has ExecuteCommand/ArmSnapshot/CleanupSubscription, not Join. subscription_state is a gauge of current joins.
No farm-side fanout counter. farm_downlink_rpc_attempts_total{method=deliver_batch} is RPC attempts; farmgate_downlink_writer_enqueued_items_total{kind=farm_change} is gate enqueue, not farm fanout.
Current subscriptions broken down by join state; SUM across state labels is the live subscription count.
No version-ring metric in capture or Go (grep version_ring/VersionRing/ring_depth empty). post_ready_buffer_len is a different buffer.
Proven due work depth, labeled by family; SUM across family is process due depth. Present on both workers.
Same oldest-due-age quantity; exported in milliseconds. Adapter must divide by 1000. MAX across family.
Duration of one bounded recovery scan by family. Unit is milliseconds, not seconds.
Durable work leases claimed by recovery family. SUM across family. Distinct from farm_workflow_recovery_claimed_total.
Durable recovery work completed by family. SUM across family.
Durable recovery retries scheduled by family.
theftrecovery.RoundStats.InvalidOrders is in-memory only; no Prometheus registration (grep Name/invalid_order in worker packages).
Participant steps with an unknown response boundary by family.
No worker-side client RPC histogram. farm_worker_terminal_latency_ms is creation-to-terminal work latency, not participant RPC. farm_rpc_server_seconds ExecuteStep is on player/farm.
No drain-rate gauge. farm_workflow_backlog / farm_worker_due_depth are depths. Deriving rate from completed_total is forbidden substitution.
Same gauge already labeled family=CARE|FRIEND_PROJECTION|GUARD_SYNC|HARVEST|MAIL|PLANT|THEFT.
Same counter already labeled by family.
